question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT with respect to Start-Up India Seed Fund Scheme?

options.text: Rs. 845 crore will be provided as seed fund.
It is being implemented by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.
The number of estimated beneficiaries are 3,600 start-ups through 300 incubators.

solution:
The correct answer is__** **____**Rs. 845 crore will be provided as seed fund**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade **(DPIIT) has created the Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS) with an outlay of **INR 945 Crore** to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of Concept.** Hence, option 1 is incorrect**.
 
• The Startup India Seed Fund Scheme is being implemented by the government with effect from 1 April 2021.
 
• It will support an estimated 3,600 entrepreneurs through 300 incubators in the next 4 years.
 
• It provides financial assistance to eligible departments for the Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade. 
 
• The Ministry of International Trade and the Ministry of Industry was split off from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry in July 1963.
 
• Amrit Kaur was a member of Jawaharlal Nehru's first cabinet following India's independence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Grants of up to ₹5 crores shall be provided to eligible incubators selected by an expert committee.
 
• They shall be offered grants of up to ₹20 lakh for validation of proof of concept, prototype development, or product trials.
 
• Furthermore, investments of up to ₹50 lakh shall be provided to startups for market entry, commercialization or scaling up through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments.

8d:T
